content: Babior We Mo Fadiyel Saaf We
Iwiri sew babior le ye lul le yeramtawe ye maroro woal chiya we ye holu lal paol rela gilemra; rorure babior we ngo ye choy loh irel teftaf ngo ye mmaech fengal le fusuw mekla kkamchol fengal.
Ngo iwiri semal angelus kowe ye kel le ye maliliy le ye hapallingi yalol le ye sor bo, “Itey le yor igegal le yebe hatawsi meka kkamchol fengal babior le ngo yesa yaldaloh babior le?”
Iwe ngo tor semal mo wol laeng hare wol talop hare faelyayulol le yebe yoh ngali le be yaldaloh babior le bo yebe kallong iyang.
Iy sa tang bo ye tayikof lal depey irel molwe yela tor semal le ye yor igegal le yebe sugu babior le bo be kemahoy hapatpat kala ye mel iyang.

Iwe ngo semal mo luwulur mal kowe re tagiyet yesa kangaluyey bo, “Ho towe ma tang. Kalloh! Raywong we ye budoh mo irel haleng we yael Judah ngo iy chol daowe yael David ila yesa kel. Yebe yoh le be hatawsi rofusuw meka kkamchol babior la ngo yesa yaldaloh.”

Iwe ngo isa wiri semal Fadiyel Saaf le ye su lochochol chiya we liliyer tamol ngo angelus kowe famal mo mal kowe re tagiyet re tebalililoh. Ngo fadiyel Saaf la ila ye molow ngo ye llehal molwe resa mwol limeseloh. Ngo fusuw mekla taelengal le ye wochog taelengel karbow ngo fisfos metal, le ikla mele espritu we fismol we re ye yengang ngal Deus, ngo Deus ye fangloh ir wol pangal loh talop le.
Fadiyel Saaf we sa loh sala hasi babior we mo irel yeramtawe ye maroro wol chiya we ngo ye holu babior we lal paol rewe gilemra.

Yodwe ye foru molwe, ngo angelus we famal mo mal tagiyet kowe riyeg mo famal resa ppung hasubgudiy wototol mo imol fadiyel Saaf we. Semal ir ngo ye hasi sew harp mo sew tohoh hoal le ye ssogol incense bo ikla mele yar mapel mekla lol Deus.
Resa yawli sew ton le ye tefoy:

content.text: “Gel mele yor igegem le hobe hasi babior le
Bo gel mele re limesehloh, ngo irel yam tapeli maligach yam mes, mele ho foru bo pangal yarmat ngo rebe mel bo lol Deus,
le yarmetael sew mo sew haleng, mo chol sere mo sere lam, mo pangal metmetael yarmat.
Hosa forur bo chol sew lam le rebe mel bo temarong bo rebe yengang ngal Deus la yach,

content: Isa wol kalloh isala wiri ngo irongrong yalor angelus le re cholop, cholop le re towe pangeg le re su tebalililoh chiya we liliyer tamol, mo angelus we famal lengchel chiya we liliyel tamol mo mal kowe re tagiyet.
Re toton le ye palleng yalol yar ton le re sor bo:

content.text: “Fadiyel Saaf we resa mwol limeseloh ila ye fel
le yebe lamli pangal formel ngo ye loh ngali falmay,
repiy, kkel, mo ssor ngo iy mele sibe hapingpinga!”

content: Iwe ngo panger metmetal mael molow woal laeng, woal talop, mo falyayulol mo leted, iwe mo pangal loh mekla ye molow lal yayural ngo irongrong yalol yar ton le re sor bo:

content.text: “Ngali yeramtala ye maroro wol chiya la liliyel tamol mo Fadiyel Saaf la, sibe hapingpingar ngo si hasrowur ngo re bele lamli pangal formel le tor siyal!”

content: Angelus kowe famal resa hatefaeli ngo resa sor bo, “Amen!” Iwe ngo mal kowe re tagiyet resa ppung hasubgudiy wototol ngo resa hasrowu.
